payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (220ab93). CallControlPlane state machine ported from call-control-plane.ts: create/accept/decline/join/leave/end/set_media_state over the object+stream stores, brokering the MediaPlaneAdapter (allocate on create, issue grant on join, release on end). Authz + state invariants enforced (creator-only invite/end, invitee-only join, no-action-on-ended, own-media-state, distinct-active-user capacity). Records persist via to_value+upsert_object_with_policy and read via rmpv from_value; events append to CallEventStream. Injectable CallClock (determinism seam). is_signal_member backs the FR-284 gate. 8 lifecycle/authz/capacity tests vs a real in-memory FrickStore + fake media plane; clippy -D warnings + fmt clean. SFU media negotiation deferred to FR-287/288. REMAINING for full wire functionality: the CallCommand frame (21)->control plane->CallCommandResult (22) routing (the FR-282 routing half).
